verdict.rationale: Fivetran's documented model writes synced data into the user's own warehouse or data lake, including in open table formats, so that data stays with the user if they leave. The evidence does not document an export or exit path for Fivetran-held assets such as connection configs, schemas and history, and it does not name which open formats are used. missing for 10: documented account/config export or offboarding path, specifics of which open table formats are supported, independent corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Automatically sync query‑ready, fully‑managed data to your data lake in open table formats.
Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
You can either add the models in the Fivetran dashboard (Quickstart data models) or import them into your dbt project (Fivetran data models).
Fivetran has become the default in getting data out of tools you already pay for directly into a controlled space.
